notes: Exclusion limit on hidden photon (dark photon) kinetic mixing parameter ϵ vs. mass mX extracted from TEXONO neutrino experiment data. The paper derives 95% CL upper limits on ϵ by analyzing the ν̄e−e− scattering cross section measurement. Key findings: (1) For mX ≳ 20 eV, the limit is only slightly weaker than prior work due to ϵ⁴ dependence; (2) For mX ≲ 20 eV, sensitivity is drastically reduced due to oscillation effects and effective photon mass in matter (mγ ≈ 20 eV); (3) The paper corrects theoretical treatment of photon-hidden photon oscillations and accounts for anti-Compton selection efficiency. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 1 (the exclusion boundary in the log-log plane). The paper emphasizes that neutrino experiments are insensitive to hidden photons lighter than ~0.05–0.1 eV due to coherence and absorption effects. The resonance region (mX ≈ mγ) could yield enhanced sensitivity but requires detailed knowledge of reactor and detector materials unavailable to the authors. | selector: text (sole candidate)
